audit.why: packet.levelChart (Skill x5, Locke at first item, Skill at 2+) matches full phases[].side and content win[] exactly. The 43.85% winRate is harsher than the chart implies, but the chart's shape is corroborated by both layers and the mirror made no change, so I did not flip rows on winRate alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 all-in is the page's whole plan and it hangs on Satchel Charge being unavailable, yet the cooldown is never stated. Satchel is 20/18/16/14/12s, Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s, Bouncing Bomb is 6s falling to 4s.
audit.why: 'Pre-empt his escape' is only a plan with the 20 seconds attached — that is how long a Locke has to kill him after the Satchel is spent.
audit.corrected: 20s added to spikes[1], the 16s minefield and 6s Q cadence added to early and spikes[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text says 'his short range on everything means...' — the opposite of the truth. Bouncing Bomb is 850, Satchel Charge 1000, Hexplosive Minefield 900 and Mega Inferno Bomb 5000. Ziggs out-ranges Locke's 950 Q and vastly out-ranges the 425 E, which is precisely why the lane is a walk-up problem.
audit.why: A player told Ziggs is short-ranged will try to trade at range and lose the lane doing it. The correct read is that he wins every range exchange, so Locke's whole game is the walk-up behind the wave and the level 6 blink.
audit.corrected: Range comparison stated honestly; the gap-close reframed as the answer to being out-ranged rather than a consequence of him being short.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mirror flagged that Locke's kit tags W with trueDamage and R with grounding while Riot's descriptions mention neither.
audit.why: I made no true-damage or grounding claim on this page for the same reason — and none is needed here, since Ziggs has no dash for a grounding to deny. His Satchel self-knockback is a displacement, not a dash.

edits.before: Ziggs pokes with Bouncing Bomb (Q) and zones with W Satchel and E minefield; you have to walk the wave sidestepping Q, but his short range on everything means your Q Ritual Nails slow and P on-hit set up your gap-close.
edits.after: Ziggs pokes with Bouncing Bomb (Q) every 6s and zones with Satchel Charge (W) and Hexplosive Minefield (E); he out-ranges you at 850-1000, so sidestep the bomb and let your Q slow and P on-hit set up the gap-close.

edits.before: This is your kill window: E Ashen Pursuit blinks over his E minefield, W Soul Ignition burst plus R Purgatory execute delete an immobile Ziggs, and his only escape is W Satchel self-knockback which you can pre-empt.
edits.after: This is your kill window: E Ashen Pursuit blinks over his minefield and W plus R delete an immobile Ziggs. His only escape is Satchel Charge — 20 seconds at rank 1, so commit the moment he spends it.

edits.before: Skill matchup early: Ziggs' Q poke and E minefield zone you, but everything he has is short-cast, so sidestep the bomb, use Q Ritual Nails slow and P Silver Stake on-hit, and walk up behind the wave. Don't eat free Q bounces.
edits.after: Skill matchup early: Ziggs' Q poke and a 16-second Hexplosive Minefield zone you, and he out-ranges everything you have, so sidestep the bomb, use your Q slow and P on-hit, and walk up behind the wave. Don't eat free Q bounces.

notes: The page claimed Ziggs has 'short range on everything' — he out-ranges Locke on Q (850), W (1000), E (900) and globally on R. Corrected, and the level 6 plan now carries Satchel Charge's 20-second rank-1 cooldown, which is the actual size of the kill window. QUESTION: winRate here is 43.85% over 577 games while the chart says Skill on five rows and Locke at first item — the chart may be too generous, but both layers and the packet agree, so I did not flip it on the win rate alone.
